about:
I'm a Business Consultant at BR One (www.linkedin.com/company/broneconsulting) where we help businesses on their ERP and Digital Transformation projects by delivering tailored Change Management and End User Training services. This ensures the users adopt and embrace the new ways of working and it maximises the return on the investment for the business.

BR One's services benefits all the key stakeholders on ERP projects;

➡ Users - you understand the change benefit & impact, and you have the knowledge and ability to use the new system as intended
➡ Project Managers - you get to focus on delivering the solution, we get the business ready for it
➡ Finance Directors - you will maximise the return on investment
➡ IT Directors - you will deliver a successful project with minimal disruption to day-to-day activities
➡ HR & L&D Directors - your team will be fully equipped, trained, and have the ability to succeed
➡ System Implementation Partners - your solution will be used the way it was designed to be used, your client will be happy
